cases.name: standard fortigate form
cases.body: <html><body><form action="/" method="post"><input type="hidden" name="4Tredir" value="http://neverssl.com/"><input type="hidden" name="magic" value="0a1b"><input type="text" name="username"><input type="password" name="password"><input type="submit" value="Continue"></form></body></html>

cases.name: form magic overrides probe magic
cases.body: <form action="/" method="post"><input type=hidden name=magic value=ffee99><input name=username><input type=password name=password></form>

cases.name: empty magic value keeps probe magic
cases.body: <form><input type=hidden name=magic value=""><input name=username><input name=password type=password><input type=hidden name=4Tredir value="x"></form>

cases.name: uppercase tags and attributes
cases.body: <FORM ACTION="/" METHOD=POST><INPUT TYPE=HIDDEN NAME="magic" VALUE="aa"><INPUT NAME="username"><INPUT TYPE=PASSWORD NAME="password"></FORM>

cases.name: picks the form with the credential fields
cases.body: <form action="/search"><input name=q></form><form action="/"><input type=hidden name=magic value=m2><input name=username><input type=password name=password></form>

cases.name: renamed username field
cases.body: <form><input type=hidden name=magic value=m><input name=user_id><input type=password name=password></form>

cases.name: configured field names
cases.body: <form><input type=hidden name=tok value=t9><input type=hidden name=r value=back><input name=uid><input type=password name=pwd></form>
